currentStatus.description: Current status of the defect group

allowedTransitions.description: Statuses the defect group is allowed to transition to

inserted.description: Links actually inserted; already existing ones and links for defect groups missing from this repository are skipped

comment.description: Optional comment attached to every status-change activity (max 1023 characters)

updated.description: Number of defect groups the status change was applied to

content.description: Optional custom comment text for the defect group activity. If not provided or empty, a default comment will be generated automatically based on the ticket URL changes. Default comments follow the pattern: 'Ticket URL set: <url>', 'Ticket URL changed from <old> to <new>', or 'Ticket URL removed'.
examples: Linking to JIRA ticket for tracking this security issue

statusChanges.description: Map of status type (APPSEC, PR_SCAN, UPLOAD, BACKGROUND_SCAN) to status value (ENABLED, DISABLED). Supports both full and partial (delta) updates.

engineTypeStatusChanges.description: Map of engine type (SA, SCA, SAST, SECRETS, SBOM_SPDX_GEN, SBOM_CYCLONEDX_GEN) to status value (ENABLED, DISABLED). Supports both full and partial (delta) updates.

appsecRepositorySettings.description: Opt-in repository-level feature settings to apply. An absent bag or an absent inner field means "leave the current value unchanged" (partial update)

defectGroupUuid.description: UUID of the defect group with you would like to add comment to. Exactly one of defectGroupUuid or defectGroupPublicId must be provided.

defectGroupPublicId.description: Public id (#N) of the defect group. Exactly one of defectGroupUuid or defectGroupPublicId must be provided.

defectGroupUuid.description: UUID of the defect group to attach the links to

publicId.description: Public per-repository number of the defect group (the #N shown in the UI)

status.description: New status: one of the DefectGroupStatus enum names

defectGroupId.description: Internal numeric ID of the defect group (deprecated, use defectGroupUuid instead)

defectGroupUuid.description: UUID of the defect group. Takes priority over defectGroupId when both are provided.

type.description: Link type. SOURCECRAFT_ISSUE and SOURCECRAFT_PR carry a platform identifier, EXTERNAL_URL and YA_TRACKER carry an HTTPS URL.

identifier.description: Platform ID of the issue or pull request (a number or a UUID), or the HTTPS URL for URL-typed links

ReportUploadForm.description: Multipart form for uploading a security analysis report.

file.description: Raw report file content, or a ZIP archive with exactly one report file in the archive root. Do not include directories or extra files. The uncompressed ZIP entry must be no larger than 100 MB.

commit.description: Full SHA commit hash identifying the scanned code revision.

engineName.description: Human-readable name of the analysis tool that produced the report.

engineType.description: Category of the analysis engine. Defaults to UNSPECIFIED when absent.

scanBasePathAbsolute.description: Absolute path where the scan ran; stripped from report file paths for normalization.

scanTime.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the scan was initiated.

shouldTriggerEnrichment.description: When true, run additional security enrichment (SCA, risk scoring, etc.).

isReactive.description: When true, respond 202 immediately and process the report in the background; otherwise process synchronously and respond 200 (or 400 on parse errors).

scanUuid.description: Scan UUID. Used as the HMAC payload for SBOM upload tokens.

mergeScaDefectGroupsByPackage.description: When true, new SCA defect groups are merged by package/library name without version. Null in a request means "leave the current value unchanged".

appsecStatuses.description: Map of status type name (APPSEC, PR_SCAN, UPLOAD, BACKGROUND_SCAN) to status value (ENABLED, DISABLED).

engineTypeStatuses.description: Map of engine type (SCA, SAST, SECRETS, SBOM_SPDX_GEN, SBOM_CYCLONEDX_GEN) to status value (ENABLED, DISABLED).

appsecRepositorySettings.description: Effective repository-level feature settings (every field populated with its current value).

examples: This looks like a false positive

post.summary: Start generating a PDF or SARIF report
post.description: Starts asynchronous report generation for a repository scan (the latest scan when `scanUuid` is omitted). `format` selects PDF (default) or SARIF; for SARIF, `engineType` selects the combined report (UNSPECIFIED, default) or a single engine (SECRETS/SCA/SAST/DAST). Returns a long-running operation to poll via `GET /v1/reports/operations/{operationUuid}`. If a report already exists for the slice, a completed operation referencing it is returned without regeneration; if generation is already running, the in-flight operation is returned.

parameters.description: For SARIF: engine slice to generate — UNSPECIFIED (default) for the combined report, or SECRETS/SCA/SAST/DAST for a per-engine report. Ignored for PDF.
parameters.name: engineType
